did.unittitle: The Charles William Romeyn Collection of Art and Architectural Photographs

corpname.part: Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library Special Collections

did.abstract: Eleven leather-bound volumes of mounted, unlabelled architectural photographs documenting a late 19th-century European and Middle East tour of Charles William Romeyn, American architect. Each volume inscribed: "The Charles William Romeyn Collection of Art and Architecture Photographs Presented to the Yale Club Library by His Son Radcliffe Romeyn '12S." Many photographs purchased from professional photographic studies, some with identifying information on the photograph. Of significant interest for pre-World War I views of a selection of major European cities and historic buildings.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Eleven leather-bound volumes of mounted, unlabelled architectural photographs documenting a late 19th-century European and Middle East tour of Charles William Romeyn, American architect. Each volume inscribed: "The Charles William Romeyn Collection of Art and Architecture Photographs Presented to the Yale Club Library by His Son Radcliffe Romeyn '12S." Many photographs purchased from professional photographic studies, some with identifying information on the photograph. Of significant interest for pre-World War I views of a selection of major European cities and historic buildings.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Photographs mounted in bounded volumes organized geographically by country. One volume per box. All bindings in poor condition with significant loss to spines; photographs in generally good condition.

custodhist.head: Custodial History
custodhist.p: This collection was originally stewarded by the Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library at Yale Library. In July 2026, the collection's stewardship was transferred to Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library.
